statement.excerpt: If things go up and up until they don’t, OpenAI is toast.

from_speaker: If things go up and up until they don’t
Context identifies revenue from paying big business customers as necessary to meet revenue projections.
our_interpretation: The plain reading is that OpenAI would fail financially if its revenue stopped growing after a period of growth.
The immediate context emphasizes paying business customers, although 'things' could refer to overall revenue or demand.
'Toast' means business failure, insolvency, or a rescue necessary to avert failure. Ordinary fundraising, losses, or a missed target do not alone meet that description.
A revenue stall requires comparable revenue measurements showing that growth stopped. Slower positive growth and revisions to estimates do not establish a stall.
The surrounding revenue projections do not supply a deadline for this conditional forecast.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable records establish the revenue-stall antecedent, followed by documented business failure, insolvency, or a rescue necessary to avert failure.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After a verified revenue stall, financial records establish durable viability without a necessary rescue. Continued growth or temporary survival alone would not contradict the forecast.
